scope: Read-only screening of exposed layers.0 and input-embedding gradient reduce-scatter tails. Preserve FP8, compile, SAC, loss normalization, gradient accumulation count, dense AdamW, EMA and checkpoint semantics.

recommendations.mechanism: Early FFN group with matching callable, compilation, activation-checkpoint and GFSDP boundaries
recommendations.opportunity: Three FFN wgrad candidates finish about6.4ms before remaining GDN/norm kernels end, consistently in all3microbatches.
recommendations.limitations: Producer labels inferred from source-order FP8 pattern, no generated FX/tensor shapes. BF16 local wgrad completion is not automatically a module-input hook or communication-buffer readiness. Smaller buckets launched after the original complete compiled block are insufficient.

recommendations.mechanism: Dedicated gradient buffer with targeted local accumulation; reduce only after the final accumulation microbatch
recommendations.potential: Replace32input-embedding reduce-scatters per optimizer update by1, keeping32microbatches and1optimizer step. Final reduction still must complete before gradient consumers.
recommendations.memory_limit: 2004MiB is dedicated retained capacity, not established incremental peak. Moving the largest group out of the shared gradient pool can shrink that pool; measure net allocation and allocator peaks.
recommendations.numerical_contract: Preserve divide_factor1.0 and update-wide token normalization; no extra division by32. Sum/reduction ordering changes FP32 rounding and needs affected-block numerical validation. No optimizer/SparseAdam substitution.

recommendations.mechanism: Carry in-flight reductions into following microbatch forward
recommendations.upstream_pattern: PyTorchFSDP2set_is_last_backward(False) defers root finalization without disabling reductions.
local_barriers: Current all-gather and reduce-scatter use the same communication stream; next embedding weight all-gather queues behind the previous tail.
Current next-microbatch input .to(device) uses non_blocking=False; actual H2D copy is followed by a blocking CUDA stream synchronization behind the root reduction dependency.
Shared data/gradient storage, allocator lifetime and rank-consistent collective order require explicit ownership.
recommendations.integration: Coordinate finalization, H2D scheduling and next-forward weight readiness; simply changing the last-backward flag does not remove these dependencies. A second full embedding gradient buffer is not inherently necessary if completion precedes its next producer.
recommendations.final_microbatch: Has no subsequent forward in this update; all reductions must finish before clipping and optimizer.

recommendations.principle: Onlyrows referenced by local input IDs receive input-embedding gradients. Route row IDs and gradients to shard owners, then accumulate into dense local gradients for the existing dense optimizer.
recommendations.shape_bound: At8192tokens, at most8192local rows;8192*4096*4=128MiBFP32 row values versus2004MiB dense input buffer, plus IDs/protocol. This is a shape bound, not a wire-volume/speedup measurement.
recommendations.blockers: Not a drop-in standard tensor-parallel vocabulary embedding: these DP ranks process different inputs. Requires custom distributed/autograd/compile/FSDP and dense-optimizer integration, duplicate-row accumulation, BF16/FP32 rounding parity, MTP ownership, EMA/checkpoint compatibility. Not an initial experiment.

measured_host_boundary.interpretation: The copy and synchronization share aten::copy_ parent43241. The H2D transfer is enqueued early but executes after the preceding reduction/accumulation; the host blocks waiting. The29.893ms includes already queued backward/communication, not an additional removable delay.

primary_references.mechanism: Expected gradient-readiness counts and last-microbatch communication; standardDDPoverlap_grad_reduce is not evidence for per-microbatch cross-microbatch FSDP overlap.
Row-wise nonpooled embedding sharding and embeddingall-to-all; analogy only, no recommendation to replace the optimizer or install TorchRec.

remaining_gates: Actual changed compiled/GFSDP readiness and reductions
Per-rank consistent schedule and final flush
Loss/input/weight-gradient comparisons including accumulation and MTP
no_runtime_execution: No source/config changes, GPU experiments, benchmarks, installs or new training runs.

host_boundary_queries.sql:
SELECT id,parent_id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 dur_ms,arg_set_id
FROM thread_slice
WHERE ts <3762433098211544+859200000 AND ts+dur>3762433098211544+827800000
AND name IN ('cudaStreamSynchronize','cudaDeviceSynchronize','cudaEventSynchronize','aten::item','aten::_local_scalar_dense')
ORDER BY ts LIMIT 40;

WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (
 SELECT id,parent_id,name,category,ts,dur,arg_set_id,0 level FROM thread_slice WHERE id=43244
 UNION ALL
 SELECT s.id,s.parent_id,s.name,s.category,s.ts,s.dur,s.arg_set_id,a.level+1 FROM anc a JOIN thread_slice s ON s.id=a.parent_id WHERE a.level<20)
SELECT id,parent_id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 dur_ms,level FROM anc ORDER BY level;

SELECT id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 dur_ms,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.correlation') correlation,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.bytes') bytes
FROM thread_slice WHERE category IN ('gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') AND ts>=3762433098211544+858650000 AND ts<3762433098211544+859300000 ORDER BY ts;
